title: Sambhejja
text: 2. Seyyathāpi bhikkhave yatthimā mahānadiyo saṃsandanti samenti seyyathīdaṃ Gaṅgā Yamunā Aciravatī Sarabhū Mahī tam udakam parikkhayam pariyādānam gaccheyya ṭhapetvā dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni || || 3. Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave || katamaṃ nu kho bahutaram yaṃ vā sambhejja udakam parikkhīṇaṃ pariyādinnam yāni vā udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhānī ti || || Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ sambhejja udakaṃ yad idam parikkhīṇam pariyādinnam appamattakāni dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhāni saṅkham pi na upenti upanidham pi na upenti kalabhāgam pi na upenti sambhejja udakam parikkhīṇam pariyādinnam upanidhāya dve vā tīṇi vā udakaphusitāni avasiṭṭhānī ti || || 4--5. Evam eva kho bhikkhave ariyasāvakassa || la || yogo karaṇīyo ti || || [page 462] 462 Sacca-Saṃyuttam LVI.
